name: Smt. Radhika & Sri. Venkatachalam
review: Sri Srinivasa Caters turned our daughter’s wedding into a royal culinary festival. The Kalyana Murungakkai Sambar, Elaneer Payasam, and hot Ghee Mysore Pak are still praised by all our guests.

name: Dr. Subramanian & Dr. Janaki
review: The reverence with which their traditional servers laid out the banana leaf meals was deeply touching. Clean, punctual, and divine food cooked with 100% pure cow ghee.

name: Ananya & Karthik Sundaram
review: Managing 3,000 guests across 3 days without a single delay or cold dish is a monumental achievement. Their live dosa counter and brass davarah filter coffee station were the absolute stars!
